symptom: A page reachable only by its URL (`Url: 'reports'`) came back from `show impact` as 'no references found' and was listed in graph_dead_assets; CATALOG.microflows had no URL column, and no document table had Studio Pro's Mark-as-used flag.
cause: An entry point is used without an inbound edge, and the catalog measured use only by refs. MarkAsUsed and Microflow.URL were read by the SDK but never written to a catalog column.
file: mdl/catalog/tables.go (microflows_data, pages_data, graph_dead_assets, schema 51), mdl/catalog/builder_microflows.go, mdl/catalog/builder_pages.go, mdl/executor/reference_target.go (entryPointReason)
fix: microflows_data gains MarkAsUsed and URL, pages_data MarkAsUsed; graph_dead_assets leaves out a document marked as used or with a URL; the no-references message of show references / show impact names the entry point. Schema bumped to 51, which also covers #2529's USER_ROLE edges that had shipped without one.
insight: A new refs edge or column needs a CatalogSchemaVersion bump, or a cached catalog keeps the old answer: #2529 added USER_ROLE edges without one and was caught only by reading the version log while adding this column. Snippets and layouts also have Mark as used in Studio Pro, but the SDK does not read the flag for them yet.
test: mdl/catalog/builder_mark_as_used_url_2241_test.go (columns for microflow, nanoflow, plain control), mdl/executor/impact_entry_points_2241_test.go (impact message for page and microflow URLs, no-URL control, graph_dead_assets)
